modelspec.observatory.UiDirectory.title: UiDirectory
modelspec.observatory.UiDirectory.description: The value of `--ui <dir>` on `modelspec train --serve <addr>` and on `modelspec observe` (story:observatory-ui-live-loss-chart), the directory of the built observatory UI, `ui/dist` after `task ui`. It is read whole before the address is bound, every regular file under it without following a symlink, and must hold `index.html`, at most 4096 files and 64 MiB; a directory that cannot be read, has no `index.html` or exceeds a limit is refused with one line on stderr and exit 1 before anything is served or run. Once bound the process prints `ui http://<bound address>/` on stderr after the `serving` line. `GET /` answers 200 with `index.html` and `GET /<path>` with the file at `<path>` under the directory, with a Content-Type from its extension; another method on such a path answers 405, and a path that names no file answers 404. A file written to the directory after it was read is not served. `modelspec train --ui` without `--serve` is a usage error.
